result.title: Fast Training-Free Low-Light Video Enhancement with a Frozen Image Diffusion Prior
result.summary: Pretrained image diffusion models can enhance low-light video without low-light training data and without retraining for a new camera. ZVRD, the only published training-free method for low-light video, is too slow to use: our implementation needs over a minute per $256 \times 256$ frame. We present a causal, training-free pipeline that adds two temporal components to a frozen MR. Illuminate image prior. Temporal input fusion recursively averages motion-compensated low-light frames before diffusion inversion. Late-start offset propagation runs the full sampling trajectory only on key frames. Each non-key frame inverts the low-noise part of its own trajectory and adds an enhancement offset warped from the latest key frame. At ZVRD's own resolution the pipeline is $261\times$ faster than ZVRD and scores better on all five metrics we report. On 13 held-out SDSD clips at $1280 \times 720$, it improves on framewise eight-step processing by 0.55 dB in PSNR and 0.034 in LPIPS and halves the warping error, in 10% less time. Measurements inside the model show why, and a linear-Gaussian model of inversion explains them. Fusion removes frame-to-frame noise before inversion amplifies it. A flow error perturbs the transported offset ten times less than it perturbs a transported state. The perceptual gain does not transfer to low resolution: at $346 \times 260$, LPIPS is worse by 0.028. At 0.65 frames per second, the pipeline is an offline method.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无训练的低光照视频增强，在冻结图像扩散先验上加入时序输入融合与关键帧偏移传播（非关键帧只反演低噪声段并叠加经光流扭曲的增强偏移），较 ZVRD 提速 261 倍且多数指标更好，但低分辨率下 LPIPS 反而下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「关键帧走完整采样轨迹、其余样本只做短程反演并搬运偏移」的 latent 复用与校正思路，可能为 LVR 中廉价复用推理期状态、减少扩散式 latent 更新成本提供核查线索，但该偏移能否跨问题迁移及误差累积尚不明确。
